_comment: Bilingual user-facing text for wechat-bridge, kept out of main.ts so wording can be edited without touching code. Loaded once at plugin startup (see loadStrings() in main.ts). {0}, {1}, ... are positional placeholders substituted by t(key, lang, ...args) in the same order the call site passes them - check main.ts before reordering a template's placeholders.

tabNotReady.zh: Claudian 会话标签页还没准备好（没有 inputController），请稍后重试。
tabNotReady.en: Claudian tab is not ready yet (no inputController). Retry shortly.

noViewOpen.zh: 没有打开的 Claudian 视图，请先在 Obsidian 里打开一次 Claudian 侧边栏。
noViewOpen.en: No Claudian view is open. Open the Claudian sidebar once.

noTabManager.zh: Claudian 的 tab manager 不可用。

tabLimitReached.zh: Claudian 标签页已达上限(10个),无法为桥接创建新标签页。请在桌面端关闭一个标签页后重试。
tabLimitReached.en: Claudian has hit its hard tab limit (10) and could not create a tab for the bridge. Close a tab in the desktop UI and try again.

listTruncated.zh: ... 还有 {0} 个更早的会话未显示，发送 /ls all 查看全部。
listTruncated.en: ... {0} more older conversation(s) not shown; send /ls all to see everything.

switchNeedsListFirst.zh: 请先发送 /ls 查看会话列表，再用 /goto 序号 切换。
switchNeedsListFirst.en: Send /ls first to see the conversation list, then use /goto <number>.

newConversationStarted.zh: 已新建对话，下一条消息将开始一个全新的会话。
newConversationStarted.en: Started a new conversation; the next message will begin fresh.

noDispatchText.zh: (这一轮没有生成文字回复。Claudian 内部可能报错并回滚了这轮对话——请去 Obsidian 里看一下有没有弹出的提示，或直接重试一次。)
noDispatchText.en: (No text reply was generated this turn. Claudian may have errored and rolled the turn back — check Obsidian for a notice, or just retry.)

noClaudeCommands.zh: 没有发现 Claude 自带的斜杠命令（可能还没打开过一次会话）。
noClaudeCommands.en: No Claude slash commands found (a conversation may not have been opened yet).

claudeCommandsHeader.zh: Claude 自带的斜杠命令（在这里发送即可直接使用，例如 /compact）:
claudeCommandsHeader.en: Claude's own slash commands (send them directly, e.g. /compact):

histEmpty.zh: 当前会话还没有任何消息。
histEmpty.en: No messages yet in this conversation.

histHeader.zh: 历史消息（发送 /hist 序号 查看对应回复）:
histHeader.en: Message history (send /hist <number> to view its reply):

listenOn.zh: 监听已开启（仅对当前对话生效）：在 Claudian 电脑客户端上发的消息也会推送到这里。切换到其他对话后监听不会跟过去。
listenOn.en: Listening enabled (scoped to the current conversation only): messages sent from the Claudian desktop client will also be pushed here. Switching to a different conversation stops it from following.

providerUsage.zh:
用法: /provider <名称>
可用供应商: {0}

providerUnknown.zh: 不认识的供应商 "{0}"。可用供应商: {1}

providerSwitched.zh: 已切换到供应商: {0}。下一条消息将在这个供应商上开始一个全新的对话。
providerSwitched.en: Switched to provider: {0}. The next message will start a brand-new conversation on it.

reconnectedPendingPrefix.zh: （插件刚重新连接，补发一条你还没回答的问题/请求）
reconnectedPendingPrefix.en: (Plugin just reconnected - resending a question/request you haven't answered yet)

askUserQuestionUsageSingle.zh: 回复 /answer 序号（如 /answer 2，多选用逗号分隔如 /answer 1,3）或 /answer 你的文字回答；/answer cancel 取消。
askUserQuestionUsageSingle.en: Reply /answer <number> (e.g. /answer 2; comma-separate for multi-select like /answer 1,3), or /answer <free text>. /answer cancel to cancel.

askUserQuestionUsageMulti.zh: 回复 /answer 题号 选项（如 /answer 1 2），可以每题分开回复，也可以一条消息用逗号或分号隔开一次答完（如 /answer 1 2, 2 3），答完自动提交；/answer cancel 取消。
askUserQuestionUsageMulti.en: Reply /answer <question#> <option#> (e.g. /answer 1 2) - either one question per message, or several at once in one message separated by commas/semicolons (e.g. /answer 1 2, 2 3). Submits automatically once all are answered. /answer cancel to cancel.

answerUsageMulti.zh: 有多道题，请用 /answer 题号 选项 的格式，如 /answer 1 2；也可以一次回答多道题，用逗号或分号隔开，如 /answer 1 2, 2 2。
answerUsageMulti.en: Multiple questions pending - use /answer <question#> <option#>, e.g. /answer 1 2. You can also answer several at once, comma/semicolon-separated, e.g. /answer 1 2, 2 2.

noPendingQuestion.zh: 当前没有待回答的问题。

questionAnswered.zh: 已提交回答，Claudian 将继续处理。

questionPartial.zh: 已记录 ({0}/{1})，请继续回答剩余问题。
questionPartial.en: Recorded ({0}/{1}) - keep answering the remaining questions.

noPendingApproval.zh: 当前没有待处理的权限请求。
noPendingApproval.en: No approval request is currently pending.

progressiveOn.zh: 渐进式回复已开启（全局生效，所有对话）：Claudian 每说完一段就会单独推送一条，不再等整轮结束才一次性回复。
progressiveOn.en: Progressive replies enabled (global, applies to every conversation): each finished chunk is pushed as its own message instead of waiting for the whole turn.

progressiveOff.zh: 渐进式回复已关闭，恢复为整轮结束后一次性回复。
progressiveOff.en: Progressive replies disabled; back to one reply per turn.

escInterrupted.zh: 已发送中断请求，已生成的内容会照常回复过来。
escInterrupted.en: Interrupt requested; whatever was already generated will still be sent back as usual.

escNothingToInterrupt.zh: 当前没有正在进行的回复可以打断。
escNothingToInterrupt.en: Nothing is currently generating to interrupt.

filesHeader.zh: 最近一轮回复中涉及的文件:
filesHeader.en: Files referenced in the most recent turn:

filesNone.zh: 最近一轮回复没有发现可识别的文件（没有双链引用，也没有涉及文件的工具调用）。
filesNone.en: No recognizable files in the most recent turn (no wikilinks, and no tool calls that touched a file).

getfileUsage.zh: 发送 /getfile 序号 获取对应文件，多个用逗号分隔，如 /getfile 1,2
getfileUsage.en: Send /getfile <number> to fetch a file, comma-separate for several, e.g. /getfile 1,2

getfileNeedsListFirst.zh: 请先发送 /files 查看这一轮涉及的文件，再用 /getfile 序号 获取。
getfileNeedsListFirst.en: Send /files first to see this turn's files, then use /getfile <number>.

fileTooLarge.zh: 文件过大（约 {1}MB，超过上限），未发送: {0}
fileTooLarge.en: File too large (~{1}MB, over the limit) - not sent: {0}

sendUsage.zh: 用法: /send <vault内的相对路径>，如 /send attachments/report.pdf
sendUsage.en: Usage: /send <path relative to the vault>, e.g. /send attachments/report.pdf

pathOutsideVault.zh: 路径必须在 vault 内: {0}
pathOutsideVault.en: Path must stay inside the vault: {0}

scheduleUsage.zh:
用法:
/schedule HH:MM 内容 — 一次性，今天没过就今天，过了就明天
/schedule YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM 内容 — 一次性，指定日期
/schedule daily HH:MM 内容 — 每天重复
/schedule list — 查看所有定时
/schedule cancel 序号 — 取消
scheduleUsage.en:
Usage:
/schedule HH:MM text — one-shot, today if not passed yet, else tomorrow
/schedule YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM text — one-shot, specific date
/schedule daily HH:MM text — repeats every day
/schedule list — show all scheduled sends
/schedule cancel N — cancel one

scheduleBadTime.zh: 时间格式不对，小时 0-23，分钟 0-59。
scheduleBadTime.en: Bad time - hour must be 0-23, minute 0-59.

scheduleInPast.zh: 这个时间已经过去了，请换一个将来的时间。
scheduleInPast.en: That time is already in the past - pick a future one.

scheduleAddedDaily.zh: 已设置每日定时提醒（每天 {0} 起）：{1}

scheduleNone.zh: 目前没有任何定时提醒。

zh: 本插件命令:
/help — 显示本帮助
/ls — 列出最近 10 个会话
/ls all — 列出全部会话
/goto N — 切换到第 N 个会话
/new — 新建对话
/status — 查看模型/思考强度/权限/监听状态
/hist — 列出当前对话你发过的消息
/hist N — 查看第 N 条消息的回复
/listen on|off — 开关监听（开启后电脑客户端消息也会推送到这里）
/answer — 回答 Claudian 反向提出的问题，按推送里的格式回复
/approve accept|always|deny|cancel — 回应 Claudian 的权限请求
/progressive on|off — 开关渐进式回复（每说完一段就单独推送）
/esc — 打断当前回复（已生成内容仍会照常发回）
/files — 列出最近一轮涉及的文件，配合 /getfile 使用
/getfile N — 获取 /files 列出的文件，多个用逗号分隔如 /getfile 1,2
/send <路径> — 直接发送 vault 内某个文件
/schedule HH:MM 内容 — 定时推送提醒到微信，发送 /schedule 查看完整用法
/model <名称> — 切换模型，如 /model opus
/effort <等级> — 切换思考强度，如 /effort high
/permission <模式> — 切换权限模式，如 /permission yolo
?/provider <名称> — 切换供应商（会开始新对话），发送 /provider 查看可选项
/commands — 查看 Claude 自带的斜杠命令
其他任何文字 — 直接发给 Claudian（Claude 自带的斜杠命令也这样发）
en: Bridge commands:
/help — show this help
/ls — list the 10 most recent conversations
/ls all — list every conversation
/goto N — switch to conversation number N
/new — start a new conversation
/status — show model/effort/permission/listening state
/hist — list your messages in the current conversation
/hist N — show the reply to message number N
/listen on|off — toggle listening (desktop messages get pushed here too)
/answer — answer a question Claudian asked back, in the format shown in the push
/approve accept|always|deny|cancel — respond to a Claudian approval request
/progressive on|off — toggle progressive replies (push each chunk as it finishes)
/esc — interrupt the current reply (already-generated content is still sent)
/files — list files referenced in the most recent turn, use with /getfile
/getfile N — fetch a file from /files, comma-separate for several, e.g. /getfile 1,2
/send <path> — send a specific file from the vault directly
/schedule HH:MM text — push a reminder to WeChat; send /schedule alone for full usage
/model <name> — switch model, e.g. /model opus
/effort <level> — switch effort level, e.g. /effort high
/permission <mode> — switch permission mode, e.g. /permission yolo
?/provider <name> — switch provider (starts a new conversation); send /provider alone to see options
/commands — list Claude's own slash commands
anything else — sent to Claudian directly (also how you use Claude's own slash commands)
